overrides.value: a step of the spacing scale
overrides.reason: How far the reader scrolls past the header before the first week arrives. It is a share of the screen so the valley stays in view at any screen height; it does not space text.
The same padding follows the screen height, not the text size, for the same reason.

overrides.value: a step of the spacing scale
overrides.reason: Pulls the weeks column up by one screen so it scrolls over the sticky stage. It places the column over the scene; it does not space text.
The same margin has to match the stage, which is one screen tall whatever the text size.
